questions.question: Who confronted David about his sin with a parable?
What was the parable Nathan told?
options: A rich man taking a poor man's only lamb
A shepherd searching for one lost sheep
A sower scattering seed on many soils
A vineyard owner cheated of all his harvest
questions.answer: A rich man taking a poor man's only lamb

questions.question: David repented and said, "I have sinned against the LORD."
The prophet _____ said to David, "You are the man!"
Nathan's parable was about a rich man who took a poor man's one little _____.
